candidates.topic: The Belmez Faces — Faces That Keep Appearing in a House Floor
candidates.teaser: A woman scrubbed her kitchen floor three times — and the same human face kept coming back.
candidates.video_title: The Floor That Keeps Growing Human Faces
candidates.video_description: In 1971, a face appeared in a Spanish woman's concrete floor. She destroyed it. It came back. Scientists still have no explanation. The house still stands today.
candidates.script: A woman in Spain tried to destroy the human face staring up from her kitchen floor. She broke the concrete, poured a new slab — and within days, the face came back. Then more faces appeared. Scientists drilled beneath the house in 1971 and found ancient human remains, but that explained nothing. The faces kept changing expressions for decades. The house became a tourist site. No scientific explanation has ever held up. Do you think the ground remembers the dead?

candidates.topic: The Turritopsis Dohrnii — The Jellyfish That Reverts to Youth
candidates.teaser: There is one animal on Earth that, when it starts dying, simply becomes a baby again.
candidates.video_title: The Only Animal That Cheats Death Completely
candidates.video_description: Turritopsis dohrnii, a jellyfish smaller than a fingernail, can reverse its own aging process entirely — transforming back into its juvenile state indefinitely. Scientists call it biologically immortal for a reason.
candidates.script: When this jellyfish gets old, sick, or injured, it does something no other animal on Earth can do — it turns back into a baby. Completely. Every cell reverts to its earliest state, and the whole life cycle starts again. Turritopsis dohrnii is just 4.5 millimeters wide, but it has cracked the code scientists have chased for centuries. It can repeat this reset indefinitely. We've been searching for the secret to immortality, and it was hiding in the ocean the whole time.

candidates.topic: The Baychimo — The Ghost Ship That Sailed Itself for 38 Years
candidates.teaser: A cargo ship was abandoned in Arctic ice in 1931 — and was still spotted, crewless, sailing on its own 38 years later.
candidates.video_title: The Ghost Ship That Sailed Alone for 38 Years
candidates.video_description: The SS Baychimo was abandoned in an Arctic blizzard in 1931. Its crew left it for dead. For the next 38 years, dozens of witnesses spotted it drifting through Arctic waters — completely empty, with no one aboard.
candidates.script: In 1931, a crew abandoned their ship in an Arctic blizzard, certain the ice would crush it overnight. It didn't sink. For 38 years after, sailors, Inuit hunters, and expedition teams kept spotting the SS Baychimo drifting through the Arctic — completely empty, no crew, no engine running. The last confirmed sighting was 1969. Nobody ever boarded it for the final time. The ship simply vanished. Some vessels, it seems, refuse to be abandoned.

candidates.topic: The Stanford Prison Experiment Collapse — Day Six
candidates.teaser: Scientists planned a two-week experiment — they had to shut it down on day six because reality got too dangerous.
candidates.video_title: The Experiment That Had to Be Stopped on Day 6
candidates.video_description: In 1971, Philip Zimbardo assigned random college students as guards and prisoners in a fake jail. Within six days, the 'guards' were conducting psychological torture and the 'prisoners' were having breakdowns. The experiment was supposed to last two weeks.
candidates.script: Twenty-four ordinary college students were randomly split into two groups — guards and prisoners — in a fake basement jail. The experiment was supposed to last two weeks. By day two, guards were conducting psychological torture. By day six, prisoners were having full mental breakdowns. In 1971, Philip Zimbardo shut it down before someone was permanently damaged. Normal people had become monsters in under a week. The scariest part? The guards knew it was fake the entire time.

candidates.topic: The Great Dying — Earth's Worst Mass Extinction Event
candidates.teaser: There was a moment in Earth's history when 96% of all life simply ceased to exist — and we still aren't sure exactly why.
candidates.video_title: The Day 96% of All Life on Earth Was Erased
candidates.video_description: 252 million years ago, the Permian extinction didn't just kill the dinosaurs — it nearly ended all life on Earth. Ninety-six percent of marine species and 70% of land species vanished in what scientists call 'The Great Dying.' We still debate what triggered it.
candidates.script: 252 million years ago, something so catastrophic happened that 96% of every living species on Earth was completely erased — marine creatures, insects, plants, nearly everything, gone. Scientists call it The Great Dying, and it makes the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs look minor. Leading theories point to volcanic eruptions in Siberia that lasted a million years, poisoning the atmosphere. Earth survived, but barely. The real question is — whatever triggered it once could theoretically happen again.
